cohort: A 33-year-old gravida 2 para 0 woman with mosaic Turner syndrome and a history of recurrent miscarriages, who underwent in vitro fertilization.
finding: Early diagnosis of placenta and vasa previa via transvaginal ultrasound, coupled with multidisciplinary care, enabled a successful outcome for a patient with mosaic Turner syndrome undergoing IVF.
mod_finding: A cesarean section was performed at 35 weeks of pregnancy without complications, resulting in a newborn in good general condition.
